name: Formosa Plastics Corporation
summary: Formosa Plastics Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic raw materials, chemical fibers, and related petrochemical industrial products in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through Plastic, Polyolefin, Polypropylene, Tairylan, Chemical, and Other segments. The company offers plastic raw materials, such as polyvinyl chloride, high-density polyethylene, linear low-density polyethylene, ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer, polyethylene wax, polypropylene, polyacetal, and composite granules; and carbon fiber products.
